description: This file defines the BackwardCompatible class, which implements a compatibility strategy for grain interface versions in Orleans, ensuring compatibility with all versions less than or equal to the requested version.

classes.name: BackwardCompatible
classes.description: A singleton class implementing a grain interface version compatibility strategy that treats all previous or equal versions as compatible.

methods.name: Singleton
methods.description: A static property that provides the singleton instance of BackwardCompatible.
